title: Roku raises streaming hardware prices by up to $50
summary: Roku has increased prices across its streaming hardware, with the cheapest HD Streaming Stick now priced at $39.99 instead of $29.99, as first reported by The Desk . Fox announced plans to acquire Roku last month .
